name: r2b getOwnPropertySymbols on an any-typed object literal
source: function main(): void { const s = Symbol('s'); const w: any = { [s]: 1, x: 2 }; console.log(Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(w).length, Object.keys(w)); const w2: any = {}; w2[s] = 3; console.log(Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(w2).length); }
